title: Table 6. Scope of STM32 embedded memory protection features
text_helper: Table 6. Scope of STM32 embedded memory protection features — section 4.4.4 External flash memories. Feature, External attack protection, Internal attack protection, Flash memory, SRAM.

notes: 1. Support of this feature in Armv6-M products is limited as constant data cannot be stored in NVM.
2. Write protection can be unset when RDP level ≠ 2.
3. The SRAM is protected by a secure area only at secure code execution. It must be cleaned before leaving the secure area.
